info.title: Foreclosure Data Hub API
info.description: Public REST API for property feeds, trustee sales, sheriff sales, tax sales, tax delinquency and early filings. Legacy property search requires a location filter; category searches support paginated browsing. Quotas depend on account and license status.

get.description: Discover property feeds or category inventory. coverage_basis distinguishes configured coverage from published delinquency metadata and sources represented in current eligible filings. Configured coverage does not guarantee current records or complete county coverage.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category. Omit for the original property feed catalog. Supply one category and no other parameters.

200.description: Successful response. The data shape depends on the endpoint and search mode.

get.description: Search across all data sources simultaneously. Paid retail requests return up to 100 rows total across all source groups; new trials return up to 10. Groups after the limit contain counts and empty records. At least one location filter (county, state, zip, or address) is required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Total listing rows across all groups: 1–100 paid or 1–10 during a new trial. Defaults to 25 when paid or 10 during a new trial. Choose a value within your remaining allowance.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Use unified for one records array with consistent field names, including source, row_id, nullable owner_first_name / owner_last_name, and file_number where supplied. The default groups source-specific records by feed.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: County name filter. Can specify multiple (e.g., county=Cook&county=Lake).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name or abbreviation. Can specify multiple.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Zip code filter. Can specify multiple.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Property address filter (partial match). Can specify multiple.

parameters.name: pre_foreclosure
parameters.description: Set true or 1 for scheduled-sale preforeclosures: sale date today or later (UTC), excluding REO-only feeds and REO asset types. Matches the dashboard filter. Listings without a known sale date, including early-stage defaults, are excluded. false or 0 disables the filter (default); other values return 400. A location filter is still required.

parameters.name: sale_date_start
parameters.description: Filter by sale date start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: sale_date_end
parameters.description: Filter by sale date end (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: owner_name
parameters.description: Owner name filter (partial match on first or last name). Only applied to sources that expose owner fields.

parameters.name: est_value_min
parameters.description: Minimum estimated value (Market Valuation). Only applied to sources with an estimated value field.

parameters.name: est_value_max
parameters.description: Maximum estimated value (Market Valuation). Only applied to sources with an estimated value field.

parameters.name: sale_days
parameters.description: Minimum lead time: sale_date_parsed must be later than today + N days (integer 1-365, unbounded above). ANDs with sale_date_start/sale_date_end. Listings without a parsed sale date stay included — an unscheduled sale cannot violate the bound. Unified mode only.

parameters.name: sale_status
parameters.description: Canonical sale-status group: active, coming-soon, for-sale, postponed, cancelled, price-reduced, back-to-bank, new-listing, sold, mortgage-foreclosure, outbid, preview, pending, hard-to-sell, nos, vacant-lot, sale-held, none. Groups merge clearly-equivalent feed statuses — e.g. cancelled covers Cancelled/WITHDRAWN/Sale Invalid, sold covers Sold/Completed/3rd-party variants, postponed covers postpone*/On Hold. none matches listings with no reported status. Unified mode only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default: 1).

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Results per page, 1–100 for paid keys or 1–10 for new trials. Defaults to 25 paid or 10 during a trial. Your remaining allowance may lower an omitted first-page size.

200.description: Successful response. The data shape depends on the endpoint and search mode.

get.description: Fetch paginated data from a single source. Max 100 records per page when paid, or 10 during a new trial. Defaults to 25 when paid or 10 during a new trial.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Data source ID (from /v1/sources).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default: 1).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Results per page, 1–100 paid or 1–10 during a new trial. Defaults to 25 when paid or 10 during a new trial.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Filter by date added start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Filter by date added end (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: County name filter.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name or abbreviation.

parameters.name: owner_name
parameters.description: Owner name filter (partial match on first or last name). Only applied when the source exposes owner fields.

parameters.name: est_value_min
parameters.description: Minimum estimated value (Market Valuation). Only applied when the source exposes an estimated value field.

parameters.name: est_value_max
parameters.description: Maximum estimated value (Market Valuation). Only applied when the source exposes an estimated value field.

200.description: Successful response. The data shape depends on the endpoint and search mode.

get.description: Get record counts per data source for a date or date range.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Single date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Range start (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with end_date.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Range end (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with start_date.

200.description: Successful response. The data shape depends on the endpoint and search mode.

get.description: Trustee Sales returns the classified dashboard inventory. Omit sale_status for all dates and statuses; use trustee-upcoming for qualified upcoming sales. The nullable trustee_status, trustee_today and trustee_upcoming fields are populated when supplied by the selected status projection. Unknown parameters and repeated scalar parameters return 400. No location filter is required. Delivered records consume applicable row allowances.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state name or abbreviation. Repeat for multiple values, at most 50.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: Partial county name. Repeat for multiple values, at most 50.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Property ZIP prefix. Repeat for multiple values, at most 50.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Partial property address. Repeat for multiple values, at most 50.

parameters.name: sale_date_start
parameters.description: Inclusive sale date start, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: sale_date_end
parameters.description: Inclusive sale date end, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: sale_days
parameters.description: Minimum sale lead time, 1 to 365 days. Tax sales require a known date and use local sale days. Trustee and sheriff searches retain undated rows unless another date filter excludes them.

parameters.name: sale_status
parameters.description: Canonical status group, including trustee-upcoming, trustee-active and trustee-unconfirmed. Omit for all trustee statuses and dates.

parameters.name: owner_name
parameters.description: Partial published owner name.

parameters.name: est_value_min
parameters.description: Minimum estimated value.

parameters.name: est_value_max
parameters.description: Maximum estimated value.

parameters.name: pre_foreclosure
parameters.description: Scheduled-sale preforeclosure filter; does not search early filing events.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Keep page_size fixed while paging.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Rows per page: 1 to 100 paid, 1 to 10 trial. Defaults to 25 paid or 10 trial. An omitted first-page size may shrink to the remaining allowance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Alias for page_size; values must match when both are supplied.

413.description: Prepared response exceeds the byte limit. Request fewer rows or narrower filters.

get.description: Tax Delinquency returns published delinquent property/account records. Read amount_kind with reported_balance; published_total is separate and nullable. These records do not imply an auction date. Starting offsets are limited to 500,000, including the second block of pages larger than 50 rows. Unknown parameters and repeated scalar parameters return 400. No location filter is required. Delivered records consume applicable row allowances.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state name or abbreviation.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: Exact county name, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Delinquency field searched by q. Parcel also searches account aliases.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the selected field; parcel also searches account aliases.

parameters.name: minimum
parameters.description: Minimum reported delinquent balance.

parameters.name: maximum
parameters.description: Maximum reported delinquent balance.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Keep page_size fixed while paging.

parameters.description: Rows per page: 1 to 100 paid, 1 to 10 trial. Defaults to 25 paid or 10 trial. An omitted first-page size may shrink to the remaining allowance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Alias for page_size; values must match when both are supplied.

get.description: Early Filings returns eligible matched properties grouped by proceeding and parcel. It includes recording dates, document references, classifications and recorded parties. state filters filing jurisdiction; situs_state describes the matched property. Internal review and unresolved-match data are excluded. Unknown parameters and repeated scalar parameters return 400. No location filter is required. Delivered records consume applicable row allowances.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filing jurisdiction as a US state name or abbreviation.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: Partial county name or qualified county key such as FL:Duval.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filing source ID from /sources?category=filings.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search instrument, case, address, legal text, and recorded parties.

parameters.name: recorded_from
parameters.description: Inclusive recording date start, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: recorded_to
parameters.description: Inclusive recording date end, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Recorded event type; results remain eligible property groups.

parameters.name: filing_kind
parameters.description: Filing classification; a candidate does not establish a completed foreclosure.

parameters.name: has_case
parameters.description: Require a reported case number.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Keep page_size fixed while paging.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Rows per page: 1 to 100 paid, 1 to 10 trial. Defaults to 25 paid or 10 trial. An omitted first-page size may shrink to the remaining allowance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Alias for page_size; values must match when both are supplied.

413.description: Prepared response exceeds the byte limit. Request fewer rows or narrower filters.
